title: Well-Defined Single Positive Depth Lift
body_html:
Well-Defined Single Positive Depth Lift

The equivalence class \(\#^+([\Sigma])\) of the target single-block datum is independent of the representative \(\Sigma\) and of the choice of \(w\) with \(M(w)=\Gamma\).
proof_html: For fixed \(\Sigma\), the fiber \(M^{-1}(\Gamma)\) is a single target-group orbit, so different \(w\)'s produce conjugate data. For an equivalent representative, the semisimple element changes by an integral centralizer term. Hensel's lemma solves \(2c+c^2=\Gamma^{-1}\Delta\) inside the appropriate integral algebra, replacing \(w\) by \(w(1+c)\) and showing the two target data are equivalent.
